text:
Type: stemmed glass candle holders, set of three
Use: holding tealights or small candles on a dining table, a mantel or a sideboard; dining room, living room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, classic
Materials: clear glass
Colors: clear transparent glass
Shape: three tall slender stems of different heights, each topped by a round cup and set on a wide flat foot, like wine glasses, light and airy as a group
Feel: elegant, festive, light, sparkling
Goes with: white tablecloths, linen, light wood, brass or silver tableware; Scandinavian, minimalist or classic dining rooms

product.name: BLOMSTER
product.description: Can be used both with candles in metal cups and with tealights.
